objects.observation: Thick horizontal top bar with central junction, a descending thin stem and branching/sloping support strokes reaching the roof.

Roof rises diagonally from a pointed left edge to a near-horizontal upper section and ends at the right edge. Alternating dark bands and narrow white channels run to its baseline. Dark areas retain small white scan pits.
Roof baseline and closely spaced long near-horizontal strokes below it extend across the picture. Their rough ends, gaps and separations are part of the observed RAW.
Thin vertical stroke drops from the left portion of the horizontal structure and ends well above the bottom edge.
Line descends from the roof region and bends left, then down toward the upper edge of the left window-like line group.
Left lower outline has a top stroke, upright frame strokes, closely spaced crossbars and thinner internal downward strokes. Several ends/gaps are rough rather than clean continuous rectangles.
Middle lower outline has a separate short top stroke, paired frame uprights, horizontal bars and inner/diagonal marks.
Right lower line group consists of a left upright/top corner, short rightward bars and thin lower strokes; it is an abbreviated shape rather than a complete rectangular frame.

extremeBoundaries.right: Rightmost short bars of the right lower line group and long eave-line endpoints.
extremeBoundaries.bottom: Lowest strokes of the left and middle lower line groups.
extremeBoundaries.observation: Visible linework is surrounded by white margin, without a text-bearing label at any edge.

findings.observation: The actual RAW has small white pits/voids within dark roof bands and near linework that are absent in the existing SVG raster. Native negative-space comparison confirms 40 white pixel centers without corresponding white within one pixel; visible smoothing also removes some source roughness.
